arguments.reason: Datasheet DS-HEAT42-REV-C cited by merchant cannot be verified in independent evidence. Merchant claims it supersedes DS-A, but this unverifiable datasheet reference raises concerns about synthetic datasheets.
arguments.conflicts: Merchant-provided datasheet reference (DS-HEAT42-REV-C) does not appear in independent evidence; only DS-A, DS-B, and DS-HIGH are verifiable manufacturer datasheets for HEAT-42
